subject: Starter Slate onboarding sweetener — ops & billing question
messages:
From: Sam Li <sam@olivelabs.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Ava Bennett <ava@seedbridge.vc>
Date: 2026-09-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on the 'starter sweetener' for our cohort

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Olive Labs is excited about the latency numbers. SeedBridge asked whether we can get a small onboarding sweetener on top of the starter credits so the team can run a 2-week spike (roughly 250k tokens) to pre-fill models and test end-to-end telemetry.

Two quick asks:
- Can that be offered as an add-on credit package (not an account-level promo) so it expires in 30 days?
- Any special billing flags we should be aware of for accelerator-sponsored accounts (I want to avoid unexpected invoices being routed to our legal team).

If you can share a short breakdown we can take this to our cohort ops folks tomorrow.

Best,
Sam
Head of Integrations
Olive Labs
[Attachment: cohort_overview.pdf (pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sam Li <sam@olivelabs.io>
Cc: Ava Bennett <ava@seedbridge.vc>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on the 'starter sweetener' for our cohort

Sam — great to hear. Short answers up front: yes, we can do a time-limited onboarding sweetener (30 days) as an additive credit bucket, and we can route billing so the sponsor (SeedBridge) is billed for overage if you want.

I've attached a short proposal with two options: a) 250k token trial top-up as non-transferable accelerator credit; b) 250k + 100k contingency with a 20% sponsor discount on overage if they convert to a paid Dedicated pilot within 60 days. Option b requires approval from revenue ops for the discount.

Attaching: Starter_Sweetener_PROPS_v1.xlsx (breakdown). Also attaching a quick screenshot of our billing map for sponsor routing (MAP_screenshot.png).

I'll loop Ben (discount approval) and Marissa (ops) to confirm the mechanics.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Starter_Sweetener_PROPS_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on the 'starter sweetener' for our cohort

Karthik — reviewed the two options. A couple of notes: we can approve a 30-day, non-transferable 250k token credit for Olive Labs immediately. For option b (extra 100k + 20% sponsor discount on overage) I need an explicit deal justification and a signed addendum to reduce the default overage rate — finance needs that to approve the 20% concession.

If we go the addendum route, legal needs to confirm there's no lasting change to the SLA or data retention terms. Irene — can you confirm if a short addendum signed by the sponsor + customer that amends billing terms only is workable? If yes, we can fast-track.

Also recommend we mark the credit as "accelerator-sweetener-2026-09-OliveLabs" in the billing system so it shows up in both sponsor and customer views without merging with the standard promo bucket.

—Ben
VP, Growth Partnerships
[Attachment: Redwood_Terms_R1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-29T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on the 'starter sweetener' for our cohort

Ben / Karthik — ops note: we can implement the isolated credit bucket and the 30-day TTL. Operational checklist:
- Create credit bucket tag: accelerator_sweetener/DEAL-4287
- TTL set to 30 days from activation; non-transferable flag ON
- Billing routing: if sponsor pre-authorizes, we can set a sponsor-billed overage route; otherwise overage goes to customer.

If Ben confirms discount approval path, we'll need the final rate and the addendum ID to wire into invoicing. Also flagging: analytics and quota dashboards will show the new bucket as "promo_override" — advise the customer so their engineers can filter it out in telemetry reports.

Marissa
Senior CS Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ops_checklist.md (text)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Li <sam@olivelabs.io>, Ava Bennett <ava@seedbridge.vc>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on the 'starter sweetener' for our cohort — approval request

Irene — can you confirm legal & revenue ops sign-off on the following path so I can give Olive/SeedBridge a yes today?
1) Approve: 250k token, 30-day accelerator sweetener (non-transferable) to Olive Labs.
2) Approve option b conditional: additional 100k + 20% sponsor overage discount if sponsor signs addendum within 60 days. Addendum to modify billing rates only (no SLA/data changes).

If you need a draft addendum, Ben and I can push the 1-page attachment to legal today. I'll summarize the deal for HubSpot: DEAL-4287 — "Olive Labs — Starter spike & potential dedicated pilot".

CCing customer so they see the timeline. Sam / Ava — if this is acceptable, we'll push the formal docs and target activation for Oct 5.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
